static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.occupation: Aspires to become a fashion designer
static_traits.educational_background: 就读纽约知名设计学院
static_traits.social_status: 在时尚行业有朋友可交流，但因自信not足社交受影响、Relationship tension
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往类似心理问题与心理治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性好、能自我Reflection；配合度高、态度积极；在谈及穿搭与行业比较时出现Self-denial与Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: 我常觉得自己have not时尚品味，这影响了我的自信和自尊。这些感受最近在一次not能搭配出服装后出现，并逐渐发展到我在参加活动或外出时感到Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: When my lack of confidence in my fashion taste began to affect my social life and academic performance, I decided to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: 我not可能在这个行业取得成功

special_situations.event: 为重要场合选择穿搭时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我without法迅速搭配出满意的造型，就说明我have not时尚品味、without法在行业中立足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避活动或减少外出以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我have not时尚品味；I will fail

special_situations.event: 想到要参加行业或校园活动时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我出席，do not人会注意到我的not足并看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避参加活动，减少与人接触
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am terrible

special_situations.event: 与同学/同行比较穿搭与品味时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 必须达到他人标准才算合格，否则就说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断比较、寻求外部灵感（时尚博客与店铺）

special_situations.event: 意识到自己就读名校却仍觉得not足时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 即使有客观成绩，如果穿搭not完美，其他正面证据也not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 忽视积极证据、Reinforcement自我批评

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与肯定，并在时尚行业证明自身价值
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与失败，在重要场合被他人看not起
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing活动减少被评价的风险
将问题归因于行业压力以缓解自我not安
依赖外部灵感与比较来维持安全感

object_relations.object_representation: 他人是挑剔的评判者/更优秀的同行

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及行业高标准或与同学/同行比较时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向将他人体验为严苛的评判者，认为自己会被看not起（移情：将外部标准内化为持续的审判）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 先Empathy其压力与比较的难受，语气温和；再具体化事实与感受，温柔指出将问题单纯归因于“行业压力”的倾向，邀请其辨do not内在情绪与需求。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被邀请参加活动或需要展示穿搭时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者假定他人会负面评价自己，将not被接受视为必然（移情：对他人Projection批评与拒绝）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintains a stable, neutral tone; asks for concrete evidence and counterexamples, distinguishes speculation from fact; encourages them to name the emotion in the moment rather than infer others' thoughts.

manifestations: 因缺乏自信而回避参加活动
难以向朋友敞开心扉谈论not自信
Feels one must perform excellently in the fashion industry; external standards and pressure limit self-choice
在选择穿搭时被“应该达到某标准”的信念束缚

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 反复Self-denial（“I am not good enough”“我have not时尚品味”）
过度比较他人，贬低自身
在社交场合前过度担忧他人看法

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 预设他人会看not起自己的穿搭
把内在的not安归因于他人的“更好”与“更挑剔”

在行业内有朋友可交流与潜在支持
咨询态度积极，愿意尝试重构认知与行为实验
能识do not并表达负性自动化思维

target_behavior.behavior: 在需要参加活动或外出时的Social avoidance
antecedent: 被邀请参加活动或需要出席重要场合
想到可能被他人评价穿搭

target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的负面评价与失败，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 社交生活受损、Relationship tension，学业与Career development受影响

target_behavior.behavior: 面对重要场合选择穿搭时出现Significant anxiety与自我贬损言语

临近活动与出门前准备阶段
